status: protocol-only; conditional acquisition authorization for independent years 2021-2022, not training authorization, no test scoring authorized
separation: Independent operational-era corpus for 2021-2022; never merge with the 2023-2025 corpus v1 (operational_gefs_imd_2023_2025_v1), the 2017-2019 GEFSv12 reforecast benchmark or any Phase 4A-4M experiment

source_families.forecast_provider: NOAA/NCEP public GEFS operational archive, noaa-gefs-pds
source_families.atmosphere_a: pgrb2ap5; UGRD 850 mb, VGRD 850 mb, HGT 500 mb, PWAT entire atmosphere
source_families.atmosphere_b: pgrb2bp5; SPFH 700 mb, PRES mean sea level
source_families.excluded: NAEFS bias-corrected, reforecast, 06/12/18 UTC cycles, members p05-p30

source_version_assumptions.known_adjacent_change: NAEFS v7 implemented 2023-12-05 for downstream bias-corrected products; those products excluded
source_version_assumptions.mandatory_gate: Before payload acquisition, inventory every scheduled date/member/hour/field and compare raw-product family, grid, parameter, level, statistical interval, cycle, ensemble identity and templates across all years; any material mismatch stops acquisition for protocol revision
source_version_assumptions.2021: NO DOCUMENTED CHANGE FOUND in selected raw GEFS families (GEFSv12 operational lineage since 2020-09-23); exact executable and GRIB metadata continuity UNKNOWN until payload validation; HEAD-only sample of 152/152 required objects present (docs/127)
source_version_assumptions.2022: NO DOCUMENTED CHANGE FOUND in selected raw GEFS families (GEFSv12 operational lineage since 2020-09-23); exact executable and GRIB metadata continuity UNKNOWN until payload validation; HEAD-only sample of 152/152 required objects present (docs/127)

schedule_rule: Every calendar date in each inclusive range, no performance- or QC-based replacement or date removal; leap day lies outside all ranges

pwat: entire atmosphere (considered as a single layer)

spatial_domains.source_grid_policy: record actual native grid per message; observed operational rainfall 0.25 degree and atmosphere 0.5 degree; normalize source north-to-south latitude and 0-360 longitude; deterministic bilinear atmosphere to target; no resolution gain claim
spatial_domains.land_mask: IMD finite/non-fill target-cell mask per date; record mask hash and valid-cell count, do not infer constant mask across dates

observation_source.product: official RF25 annual 0.25 degree daily rainfall NetCDF
observation_source.date_mapping: day1 init+1 calendar day; day2 init+2; day3 init+3; valid calendar date must exist in annual file
observation_source.timing_limitation: Annual NetCDF dates have no explicit accumulation bounds; external IMD 08:30 IST-to-08:30 IST convention is not independently encoded by these files
observation_source.test_access: 2022 file hash and header/date availability only until a later model-selection freeze and an explicit unseal; no observed rainfall values, event counts or scores. The 2021 and 2022 files were fetched with header-level validation only; the RAINFALL array was not read for either
observation_source.redistribution: local research use only; IMD redistribution rights unresolved (docs/80); the files must not be uploaded to any third party

qc_policy.selection: exact-cover dynamic programming minimizing (subtractions, segments) from decoded interval metadata; no hard-coded fallback
qc_policy.negative_intermediate: reject any cell below -(bound+1e-12); only within-bound negative roundoff normalized to zero inside frozen canonical implementation
qc_policy.missing_message: reject affected member-product if no exact interval cover; never substitute zero or relax bounds
qc_policy.case_policy: each member separately valid/rejected; c00 need not await p01-p04

eligibility_definitions.SOURCE_AVAILABLE: all index objects and required selected message byte ranges for this date and product accessible and identity-verified; record member-level gaps separately
eligibility_definitions.CONTROL_RAINFALL_VALID: c00 24h window passes frozen canonical QC
eligibility_definitions.ATMOSPHERIC_INPUTS_VALID: all six c00 variables at product atmospheric hour decode on accepted native grids, cover context and are finite on required cells
eligibility_definitions.DETERMINISTIC_ELIGIBLE: CONTROL_RAINFALL_VALID and ATMOSPHERIC_INPUTS_VALID and complete 22-feature forecast-only construction; observation not required for forecast eligibility
eligibility_definitions.P01_VALID: p01 window passes same frozen rainfall QC
eligibility_definitions.P02_VALID: p02 window passes same frozen rainfall QC
eligibility_definitions.P03_VALID: p03 window passes same frozen rainfall QC
eligibility_definitions.P04_VALID: p04 window passes same frozen rainfall QC
eligibility_definitions.FULL_5_MEMBER_ENSEMBLE_ELIGIBLE: CONTROL_RAINFALL_VALID and P01_VALID and P02_VALID and P03_VALID and P04_VALID
eligibility_definitions.REGIME_ELIGIBLE: ATMOSPHERIC_INPUTS_VALID and all 12 forecast-only regime diagnostics finite; not an observed regime truth label
eligibility_definitions.PROBABILITY_MODEL_ELIGIBLE: DETERMINISTIC_ELIGIBLE and REGIME_ELIGIBLE and valid frozen/cross-fit deterministic correction plus all 26 probability features; future models only, not authorized in Phase4D
eligibility_definitions.OBSERVATION_AVAILABLE: mapped IMD date present with at least one finite non-fill aligned target cell; sealed 2022 checks limited to metadata until future unseal
eligibility_definitions.FINAL_PAIRED_EVALUATION_ELIGIBLE: DETERMINISTIC_ELIGIBLE and OBSERVATION_AVAILABLE and nonempty identical valid-cell comparison mask; for probability evaluation also PROBABILITY_MODEL_ELIGIBLE; 2022 evaluation forbidden before unseal

split_policy.2021: DEVELOPMENT: unused by any earlier protocol; may be used for training or validation under a later frozen protocol
split_policy.2022: SEALED INDEPENDENT TEST: forecast-side acquisition and forecast-only QC permitted; IMD values, events and scores forbidden until unseal
split_policy.decision_record: Year roles were proposed in docs/124 and docs/127 (2022 sealed as the only independent test) and the project owner instructed 'continue Acquire 2021-2022 data' on 2026-10-02 without changing them. The owner may revise the roles, but only before any 2022 IMD value is read; after that the roles are fixed.
split_policy.relation_to_v1: 2023 (train), 2024 (validation/selection, reused) and 2025 (consumed final test) belong to corpus v1 and are not re-labelled by this protocol
split_policy.status: conditional on the all-year raw-source compatibility inventory; any material discontinuity requires a versioned protocol revision before payloads/training

test_sealing_policy.before_unseal: 2022 source index, forecast-only QC, metadata and hashes permitted; 2022 IMD values/events/performance forbidden; the 2022 observation file stays in imd_v2/ and is opened for header and dates only
test_sealing_policy.prerequisites: freeze and hash features, QC version, model families, hyperparameters, regime construction, calibration, thresholds, the model-selection manifest and the test-unseal manifest before any 2022 value is read
test_sealing_policy.after_unseal: one-time prespecified 2022 scoring, immutable audit log, no retuning

source_inventory_schema.denominator: all 750 scheduled date-product cases, with per-member/message rows including failure rows

phase4e_order: complete all-year index and metadata inventory
acquire 2021 selected byte ranges, hash and QC
acquire 2022 forecast selected byte ranges, hash and forecast-only QC while test observations remain sealed
acquisition_policy.transfer: official NOAA cloud index + bounded byte-range requests; immutable content hashes and receipts; retry bounded transient failures with backoff; resume by valid hash, no duplicate downloads
acquisition_policy.concurrency: retain frozen worker settings until a separately logged representative benchmark proves safe improvement; no nested oversubscription

raw_layout: data/operational_gefs/v2/{year}/{init_date}/... immutable, disjoint from v1, reforecast and Phase4A-C
derived_layout: data/operational_derived/v2/{inventory,decoded,qc,features}; data/operational_models/v2; data/operational_evaluation/v2; 2022 observation holdout access segregated
stop_conditions: material raw-source configuration/product or GRIB-interval discontinuity
required predictor or member unavailable beyond documented status
accumulation convention inconsistent with frozen windows
persistent corrupt byte ranges or hash mismatch
free disk below 40 GB or less than estimated remaining bytes plus 20 GB
IMD date alignment or coordinate semantics change
need to alter canonical QC, feature contract or split
supersedes_nothing: v1 remains frozen and authoritative for 2023-2025; v2 adds years and changes no v1 artifact
purpose: Provide years that no earlier protocol, model selection, calibration or analysis has used, so that a follow-up model (for example the geography-aware correction of docs/124 and docs/126, risk R41) can be judged on data that were not seen when it was designed
